notes: Built ugly but real vertical slice: (1) Loads 250 canonical BGer decisions from corpus lane (2020-2024, DE/FR/IT). (2) Loads pre-computed map artifacts from fractal-map lane: concat_center_tfidf (best performer) and baseline representations with 4 zoom levels (8-25 clusters). (3) Navigation API provides cluster exploration, zoom switching, decision inspection with full text, nearest-neighbor search, and text search. (4) Web frontend renders interactive 2D map with canvas, cluster highlighting, hover tooltips, click-to-inspect, and search. (5) All smoke tests pass. Architecture ready for TF base map (just add new corpus JSONL files) and user imports (same schema).
known_limitations: Corpus (250 decisions) is a subset of map (1000 decisions) - only 50 decisions have both corpus text and map positions
Cluster assignments use simple spatial grid clustering rather than actual Leiden/HDBSCAN results
No persistence of computed artifacts - recomputation required on each startup
Frontend uses HTML5 Canvas only - no WebGL/Mapbox for large-scale rendering
No authentication or rate limiting on API
next_steps: Scale corpus to match full 1000-decision map or downsample map to corpus
Integrate actual cluster assignments from fractal-map Leiden/HDBSCAN results
Add persistence layer for computed artifacts
Test with user-imported corpora (same JSONL schema)
Add map modes (legal issue, reasoning, citation views) per multi-view requirement
